text: Nobody tells you which company makes the medicine in your home. Here are ten.
Mid cap means the next hundred and fifty companies after India's top hundred. Here is what each one makes.
One. Mankind Pharma. Everyday medicines, plus pregnancy tests and antacids.
Two. Aurobindo Pharma. Generic tablets and injectables, sold mainly in America and Europe.
Three. Lupin. Asthma inhalers, TB medicines and American generics.
Four. Glenmark. Skin creams and nasal sprays for allergies.
Five. Alkem. Antibiotics and acidity tablets.
Six. Biocon. Biosimilars, like insulin for diabetes and cancer biologics.
Seven. Abbott India. Thyroid tablets, women's health, and Digene.
Eight. Gland Pharma. Injectables, made for other pharma companies.
Nine. Ipca. Pain relief and anti malaria medicines.
Ten. Ajanta. Heart, eye and skin medicines.
Remember, this is a watchlist, not a buy list. Pharma stocks can fall hard on a single US FDA warning.
Save this, and follow for more. Which one's medicine is in your home right now?
